title.narrative: RECLAIM Sustainability! Ghana - Gold

description.narrative: This project aims to foster genuine and inclusive sustainability in the ASM value chain, where the interests, voices and rights of miners and other players within the supply chain, are well represented in decision making and policy formulation making for sustainable use of natural resources, decent work, fair value distribution, and sustainable consumption.
